title: Xdrip Bluetooth contour next link 2.4
symptom: The user asks if it is possible to connect the Contour Next Link 2.4 meter via Bluetooth to xDrip. In the settings of glucose meters, the option is off and cannot be turned on.
cause: The user found that the communication is not Bluetooth but IEEE802, so the only way to connect the meter to the phone is with an OTG cable.
fix: The thread does not provide a fix for connecting via Bluetooth. It is stated that it is not yet possible without hardware and OTG cable.
evidence_quote: After reading a lot of internetpages I have found that the communication is nog bluetooth but IEEE802. So the only way to connect the meter to my phone is with aan OTG cable.
